name: Pension Maikircher
beschreibung:
Overview

Pension Maikircher is a family-run accommodation business at the address Dorf 59 in the centre of Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser, a municipality in the Kufstein region of Tirol. It is run by the Aschenwald family. The house presents itself as a breakfast and holiday guesthouse, is listed in the business directory herold.at under the category "Gasthaus u Gasthof" and is listed on the tirol.de portal as a 3-star inn. A total of twelve rooms are available to guests – single rooms, double rooms and family rooms for two to four people. The rooms are equipped with a bathroom, shower and WC, free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TV and balcony; the family rooms additionally have a bunk bed. From the rooms there is a view of the mountain world of the Wilder Kaiser. The house includes a lounge and common room with a bar, where guests can round off the evening, as well as a garden with barbecue facilities.

History/Background

The guesthouse is run by Anton Aschenwald or the Aschenwald family and is located at Dorf 59 in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser. The house explicitly sees itself as a family-run business and advertises that it is made for a cosy and at the same time inexpensive family holiday. In addition to accommodation with a breakfast buffet, it offers a guest room with a bar as an inn. A more far-reaching, reliably documented founding or construction history is not documented in the sources used here.

Arrival

The guesthouse is located at Dorf 59 in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser. According to the business, arrival from Germany is via the A12 in the direction of Munich–Rosenheim–Kufstein and on in the direction of St. Johann/Felbertauern to Ellmau. From Austria, the Czech Republic, Slovakia and Hungary, the route leads via the A1 to Salzburg, then via Bad Reichenhall–Lofer–Waidring–St. Johann to Ellmau. A vignette is compulsory on all Austrian motorways; the vignette is available at almost all petrol stations and motorway service areas near the border. According to the business directory, a customer car park is available at the house, and the guesthouse states that guests can park free of charge.

Tips

Breakfast is served as a generous breakfast buffet with products mainly from local producers. Check-in is from 14:00, check-out until 10:00. Children up to 3 years stay free of charge; for children from 3 to 10 years a discount of 50% applies, from 10 to 12 years 25% and from 12 to 14 years 15%. Four-legged favourites are welcome on prior request; the daily rate is 5.00 euros without food. For weekend bookings (Thursday to Sunday) and short stays of up to three nights, a surcharge of 5.00 euros per person per day is charged. A deposit of 30% of the total price is required. The stated opening hours of the catering establishment are daily from 11:00 to 23:00 without a closing day.

Best time to travel

The business offers both a winter and a summer programme and thus caters to guests in both seasons. The region around the Wilder Kaiser and the adjacent SkiWelt are popular destinations for active holidays in both winter and summer. A generally valid recommendation for the best time to travel cannot be derived from the sources; anyone planning specific activities should enquire with the business in advance.
